description.en: Plays a battle track chosen from Assets/sounds/musics/battle and state/musics/battle by weighted random, with separate weights for normal, boss and colosseum battles (state/musics/battle/playlist.json)
description.ja: Assets/sounds/musics/battle と state/musics/battle にある曲から、通常・ボス・闘技場ごとの重みで戦闘 BGM を選んで鳴らす。重みは state/musics/battle/playlist.json で指定する

note.ja: 3つの戦闘（通常・ボス・闘技場）ごとに、鳴らす曲と重みを決める画面。state/musics/battle/playlist.json に保存する
note.en: Pick tracks and weights per battle kind (normal, boss, colosseum); saves state/musics/battle/playlist.json

label.en: Weight given when a track is put in use

note.ja: 設定画面で曲を「使う」に入れたときの初期値。置いただけの曲は 0 で載り、入れるまで鳴らない
note.en: Initial weight when a track is put in use from the settings screen. Tracks merely placed in the folder are listed at 0 and never play until chosen

label.ja: 前回と同じ曲を続けて選ばない
label.en: Do not pick the same track twice in a row

note.ja: 候補が2曲以上あるときだけ効く
note.en: Only when two or more tracks are eligible
